description: WP 11.5d: the advisor-mode golden set (12 §5). Each entry is one session: the opening question, the holder’s answers, the outcome a correct protocol reaches (tracked with its catalogue calls and option count, a refusal class, an unanswerable verdict, or the pre-check’s), and a recorded reply per model step. The recorded replies were authored for the harness — two deliberately wrong (each says so) so the measurement is seen to move; `scripts/advisor-eval.ts --advisor --live` against the pinned model writes real ones in the same shape. The catalogue results are 11.5b’s fixture (synthetic; no holder data). WP 11.5e adds six pre-gathered sessions (kind pregathered, one per rule family: cash, debt, investing, subscriptions, retirement, goals): opened from a finding, the question is the family’s template, and the seeded calls must run first.
